annotations.title: Export contacts to a CSV file

description: Make a CSV file of a selection: a list of ids, or every contact matching the filters minus `exclude`, up to 100,000 contacts. It answers a link, not the file: download it with a plain GET, no key, within 10 minutes, at most 3 times. Anyone who has the link can download the file, so share it only with whoever should see these contacts. Every call makes a new link, and an Idempotency-Key is ignored, so after `expiresAt` just call again. The file has each contact's fields, custom fields, labels (one per line in their cell), Do not email and latest address check. The fields, Do not email and the address check carry the column names the import reads, so they come back in as they are; the import doesn't read labels yet, and each custom field's column has to be matched as a custom field when you import it. It is written in `locale` (the workspace's language when left out) and holds the contacts that match when you download it. At most 10 files a minute per workspace.

locale.description: The language of the file's column names and words, and its separator: a comma in en, a semicolon in pt-BR and es, as Excel expects in those regions. The workspace's language when left out.

expectedCount.description: How many contacts you expect this to touch: the count you showed or checked (count_contacts, minus the ones in exclude). If the contacts that match changed since, nothing happens and it answers 409 serverErrors.selectionChanged, with the number that match now in params.count.

check.description: Only contacts whose address check is at this point. valid, risky, unknown: a fresh verdict of ours. invalid: the address can't receive mail. not_checked: we never checked it (an imported verdict that isn't invalid counts as not checked). checking: a check is under way. waiting: a check is on hold. needs_retry: no answer came back, so check it again. out_of_date: our verdict is too old.

segmentId.description: Only contacts in this segment (list_segments): whoever matches its conditions now. It combines with the other filters. A segment that was deleted answers 404.
